lines.en: There’s a place in Kumon-mi that’s always dark.
A place the light can not reach for reasons unrelated to God or god or however you’re feeling today.
That place is just a sketchy basement, though. So take that stupid tin foil hat off and get back in the game. Both literally and figuratively.
: Aaaaaaaaaah-
: Not loud enough.
: Aaaaaaaaaahhhhh-
: Still not impressed. Gonna need some more.
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH-
: Pathetic. Is this your first time singing? Were you literally just born?
: Jesus, Niki! Some pointers might help if you’re that unimpressed! It’d be better than just lying there and bitching at me all afternoon, that’s for sure!
: What do I know about singing? I’m just some idiot who threw her career away for some dude who’s probably going to fuck you and my entire agency by the end of the year.
: Don’t be ridiculous, Niki. Akira and I are at least two years away from that sort of development.
: Why is life so miserable, Otoha?
: Oh, was today your therapy session? Sorry. I thought I had singing lessons again. You know, that thing my parents are paying you for?
: Nobody’s paying me for your lessons, brat. I’m doing this out of the kindness of my heart, remember?
: My bad. I must have forgotten that on account of Akira seemingly fucking all of that kindness out of you. Now, can we get back to improving my dynamics?
: Sure. Just, instead of “ahhhhhh,” can you go ahead and yell “Niki Nakayama is a fucking moron” this time? As loud as you possibly can for as long as you can. I want to make sure I hear it.
: Sounds easy enough when I’ve been doing that internally ever since I saw your stupid Instagram post.
: I knew the backlash would be bad but I didn’t think it’d be this bad. And I’m sure it doesn’t help that I’m now personally intimidating girls who claim to be my biggest fan either.
: If this is about Chika again, I don’t think you need to feel as bad as you probably do. She’s been kind of weirdly okay following your little confrontation.
: So what? Doesn’t mean I wasn’t too hard on her.
: She’s sleeping with your boyfriend. Like, actively. Maybe even right now. Possibly with a poster of you ominously hanging in the background as if you are observing their collective sin.
: Good. I hope my two-dimensional visage haunts that man every time he accidentally looks away from her hot teen body.
: How come you never tell me I have a hot teen body?
: Because you raped me and I don’t think you’re cute anymore.
: I did not rape you! I just...you know...did that thing we’re not really supposed to talk about anymore on account of me apparently not having a hot enough teen body.
: Oh, cry me a river. I have enough problems between an ongoing legal battle and a developing one at home to bother consoling you about the fact that we are never going to have sex.
: If you’re that set on fucking a teacher, you have plenty of access to a different one. Do I enjoy that you have this access? No! But you know what I enjoy even less, Otoha?
: His daughter having that same access and an even greater desire to fuck him than you do?
: His fucking daughter having an even greater desire to- wait, how’d you know what I was going to say?
: Because you never fucking shut up about it! Everything lately is just Ami, this! Sensei, that! Just friggin’ mentor me if you’re so opposed to having any other sort of relationship with me, Niki!
: I’m sorry, Otoha. I have neglected you. Would you like a hug?
: This is a trick question. No. I would not.
: Damn it. I could really use one right now.
: Wait, no! I changed my mind! I do want one!
: Get your mind out of the fucking gutter, Otoha! How dare you even think of accepting such a blatantly predatory gesture! Have you lost your fucking marbles?!
: No! You’re just a really confusing person when you get angry and I don’t know if I’m supposed to cheer you up or give you space!
: Neither! You’re supposed to be focusing on singing! Not me!
: WHAT DO YOU THINK I’VE BEEN TRYING TO DO THIS WHOLE TIME?!?!?
: I swear, this would all be so much easier if I could just figure out how to get through to that red-headed demon child. Why won’t she just fucking accept me, Otoha? I’ve tried fucking everything.
: Everything except the one thing you know would actually do something, you mean.
: Ahh. Yes, I did think of that as well. I don’t think lobotomies are legal anymore, though.
: I meant letting her fuck her dad without grounding her over it.
: No! I’d rather just do the lobotomy! Ami already lost her first set of parents, Otoha! The last thing she needs is the second set turning her into a cum-sock!
: I think she might like being a cum-sock, though. It feels like that’s exactly what she’s been training for.
: What she wants isn’t what she needs! It’s like you and singing from your head instead of your chest! How many times have I told you not to do that today?!
: Zero. This is the first bit of singing advice I have received in a month. I’m so happy, I could cry.
: Hah...listen. I’m sorry, okay? I know you’re probably annoyed having to put up with all of this. It’s just...I’ve never been good at dealing with...romantic drama.
: You’ve chosen a hell of a guy to spend the rest of your life with then.
: I didn’t choose him, Otoha. It just happened, okay? And it’ll happen to you one day too when you stop being so obsessed with me.
: Yeah, I don’t know about that. I’ve learned that I have basically the same taste in girls as Akira and he gets to all of them first. It’s totally unfair.
: Maybe it’s best if we just...keep your lessons on hold until I’m at a better place mentally? Because I’m clearly incapable of leaving my baggage at the door and need somebody to vent to.
: What, do you seriously not have anybody else to vent to? No...friends or anything? Just me?
: Not lately. Ado-chan’s so busy now. I can never get a hold of her anymore.
: A...Like...Like the-
: Otoha, do you want to go out to dinner tonight? As like a...thanks for dealing with my bullshit gesture?
: I...hold on...I’m still processing the...first thing you said...
: What, the Ado thing? Have I really never told you that before? We used to be karaoke buddies before Kumon-mi got closed off. We helped each other a lot when we were first starting out.
: Sooooo...dinner?
: Yeah.
: Yeah, I’ll go to dinner with you.
Five hours later...
: Not what I had in mind...
: Oh! Otoha’s here for some reason. Weird.
: Yay! Now, we can have a totally normal family dinner where we can all talk about normal things and there will be no drama at all!
: Welcome to the family, Otoha. I am sorry.
: If you guys are adopting me, does that I mean I need to be into incest as well?
: Yes.

: NO! No incest at the dinner table! Especially a dinner table that isn’t actually our dinner table! Who knows how much longer I’ll be able to afford fancy places like this?! Savor it while you can, demon!
: Hey. Quiet. You’ve got enough media attention as-is.
: Ahem. Yes, babe. You are absolutely right. I am not overwhelmed at all. I am Niki Nakayama. I am famous and talented and in love with my childhood friend.
: Sexburger!
: And soon, I will die.
: Friends of the Friend-boy! Have you been writing inside of the lines lately?
: Hi, Kaori...
: I thought she was off today...
: Is no one else going to question “sexburger?” Really?
: Hi, Kaori! I didn’t realize you worked here too.
: Ah! It is the tiny red human who once exited the phallus of my Friend as a sperm! How are-
: ...Kaori? Is everything okay?
: I...I don’t...know...
: Kaori, could you bring us some water, please? We’re not ready to order yet. And-
: And a bottle of whatever your most expensive wine is. What does everybody else want?
: Please don’t drink an entire bottle of wine at dinner.
: Dad, is something wrong with Kaori? This is starting to feel like that time we saw her in the rain.
: She’ll be fine. Kaori — water, please?
: R...Right...
: I’ll be right back with the...with the water...
: So how did you get roped into this, Otoha? Aunt Niki doesn’t normally invite other people to come eat with us.
: Good question. I was just wondering that myself.
: She must really like you, huh?
: Or hate me for subjecting me to this brand of chaotic dysfunction. I’ll take this over eating with my parents though, I guess.
: Why do you say that? Family shouldn’t be taken for granted, Otoha. You never know when you might lose them.
: No, I get that. And sorry for making it sound that way.

: I just mean that this entire thing feels kind of weird to me since I’m just not really used to it. I’d normally just scarf something down during piano lessons when I was younger. Instead of eating with my parents, I mean.
: I see what you mean I think. Dinner at my house was normally just me and Sensei and sometimes Ayane.
: Dinner at my place was always an experience. Right, babe?
: You don’t remember, do you?
: We always ate together. Akira too when he wasn’t off getting...tutored. And my parents were amazing cooks. You’ve been to the restaurant, right Otoha?
: Just once with Noriko. You two look just like your mom. It’s weird.
: Yeah...Ami too.
: Heheh! You really think so?! She was, like, way prettier than I’ll ever be, though. And my hair was way longer until I, well...you know. Scissors. Stab. Bad.
: Your mom was...a poet. Right?
: Otoha-
: It’s fine, Dad. I’m okay! And yes! Not just a poet, though. She was the poet. And she’d be super duper famous today if life was actually fair.
: Babe, want to go see if we can get a tour of the kitchen? I want to check on Kaori.
: What? But a second ago, you were-
: Oh, come on. It’ll only take a second. We’ll be right back, girls! Don’t be fucking weird, Ami.
: Joke’s on her. There’s nothing weird about being in love with your dad at all and I’m pretty sure that’s what she’s implying.
: Ami...would you mind taking it a little easier on her? Niki’s sort of falling apart if you haven’t noticed.
: Oh, I have.
: And you just don’t care? Do you dislike her or something? Because she’s, like...really trying to make this work and you’re practically just beating her into the ground.
: Oh, is that why you’re here? Is she trying to appeal to me using someone my age as bait this time?
: What’s your deal, dude? Why are you so hostile to her when she’s practically family already? You’re not like this to Noriko.
: That’s because Noriko isn’t disrupting the ecosystem. If you just decided to move into my house one day, I’d make your life miserable too.
: So it’s just her sort of...assuming the role of a matriarch that gets you all riled up?
: Not really. Like, I’d be fine with somebody like Sana’s mom moving in since I know she wouldn’t judge me the way Niki does.
: You don’t think Sana’s mom would judge you for wanting to bone your dad?
: I don’t, no. And I know that for a fact because I told her about it while she was cutting my hair and she just smiled and said “that’s nice.”
: Not exactly a five star review of your outlook.
: No, but it’s not a rejection either! And there’s nothing more annoying to me than people who think their outlook on controversial subjects is the only morally good one!
: So if Niki was open to the idea of you and Akira-
: Then she would stop feeling my wrath!
: What? Are you judging me now, too?
: A little bit, yeah.
: Okay, shotacon. Whatever you say.
: Can you knock it out with that, please?! It was one thing during the Dorm Wars, but I don’t need you saying that every single time we interact from now on!
: I mean, it’s not like I’m going to tell anyone.
: That just makes it sounds like I’m admitting to...being that thing you said!
: Ooooooh...I didn’t realize you were like my dad in trying to pretend you’re not interested in things you are interested in. Sorry, Otoha.
: That implies I’m a creep too, idiot!
: Do you think my mom was a creep, Otoha?
: What?
: I just figured you’d empathize with her outlook a little more as one of her fans.
: I........never said I was one of her fans.
: But you are, though. Right?
: And you know who my dad is...right?
: Hah! It just occurred to me how funny it is that you’ve probably been masturbating to him since before you two even met! You really do stand out after all, huh?!
: Ami! Shut up! Not everybody is as comfortable with being fucked up as you are!
: It’s not fucked up, though. I mean, I’m sure that sometimes it is, yeah. But, as a fellow reader, you surely understand just how dearly they loved one another, don’t you?
: And if you had a little boy to love like that, surely you’d be bending over some couch and letting him put his tiny little-
: Hey. Did Kaori not-
: Why is Otoha so red? What did you say to her?
: Welcome back, Aunt Niki! Otoha and I were just talking about how excited we are to see you start acting! It’s going to be so weird seeing you play characters other than just Niki now.
: Oh. Well...I do suppose that explains the color of Otoha’s face, yeah.
: Super excited...
: Anyway, did Kaori not come by with the water? Akira and I couldn’t find her, so we figured she might have been out on the floor still. He’s still looking for her in the back.
: Kaori? No, she didn’t come by at all. I hope she’s okay, though. You don’t think she got sick, do you?
: Let me text her. I’m pretty sure I still have her number somewhere.
: I think I’m going to...step outside for a minute to get some air...
: Okay, but if you leave me here I am never teaching you anything ever again.
: I’m not convinced you were ever going to anyway...
